title: OGK Kabuto Shuma Raptor TC-1

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Ogk Kabuto Shuma Raptor TC-1 is tuned for city streets, daily work runs, and weekend joyrides, delivering responsive balance and confident road feel. Featuring a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) architecture at 1434g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.06 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~88 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Track-capable with spoiler and dual-density EPS for racing use.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval to intermediate head shapes; may feel tight on very round heads due to aggressive cheek padding.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Ogk OGK Kabuto Shuma Raptor TC-1: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Ogk OGK Kabuto Shuma Raptor TC-1: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide

introduction: Positioned in Ogk's Full Face lineup, the OGK Kabuto Shuma Raptor TC-1 brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Ogk Kabuto Shuma Raptor TC-1 represents Ogk's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~88 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Ogk Kabuto Shuma Raptor TC-1 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
